image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a green iguana perched on a branch. The image focuses heavily on the head and upper torso. Visible features include a prominent dewlap, a dorsal crest of spines running down the neck, textured green scales, and a large eye with a distinct iris color. The background is blurred foliage and a fence-like structure.

The toes gripping the branch appear slightly fused or melted into the branch surface. The definition between individual claws and the wood is softer than expected for a high-resolution macro shot.
The horizontal lines in the background (top right) show slight waviness inconsistent with rigid architectural structures, suggesting minor geometric instability.
